articles.summary: Texas will limit SNAP purchases of sweetened drinks and candy starting April 1, 2026. Learn which beverages and snacks are affected under the new EBT rules.

articles.summary: Florida will limit SNAP purchases of soda, energy drinks, candy, and many prepared desserts starting April 20, 2026. Learn how the new EBT rules affect you.
articles.title: New SNAP Rules for Soda, Candy & Desserts in Florida | Forage Blog
